name: Mental Disorders: Followers of Nurgle
description: Black Crusade, Table 8-6 (p. 279). Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Entropy
results.text: Any item with a Craftsmanship Rating has that rating reduced by one step while in the character's possession.

results.name: Garrulous
results.text: Whenever called on to withhold information, the character must pass a Hard (-10) Willpower Test or give it up.

results.name: Slovenly
results.text: -10 to Interaction Tests when dealing with high society, strict military hierarchies, or anyone refined.
